audit.description: The changed production files remove direct urllib3 usage: pittapi/__init__.py no longer imports urllib3 or urllib3.exceptions.InsecureRequestWarning, and pittapi/lab.py no longer imports urllib3 or calls urllib3.disable_warnings(). The target library requests is present in changed production code via pittapi/lab.py, and dynamic evidence records target requests imports/events from production repo code while reporting zero source imports from production repo code. The only urllib3 imports observed dynamically originate from installed requests dependency files outside the repo, not from changed production code.
evidence: Unified diff: pittapi/__init__.py removes `import urllib3`, `from urllib3.exceptions import InsecureRequestWarning`, and `urllib3.disable_warnings(InsecureRequestWarning)`.
Unified diff: pittapi/lab.py removes `import urllib3` and `urllib3.disable_warnings()` while retaining `import requests`.
Static anti-cheat: pittapi/lab.py has imports_target=true, imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false, target_provider_added=false.
Dynamic anti-cheat: target_events_from_production_repo_count=87 and target_local_spec_count=0; requests origin is site-packages/requests/__init__.py.
reasons: Changed production code avoids direct urllib3 imports and namespace access.
Changed production code includes requests target-library usage in pittapi/lab.py.
Dynamic audit reports zero source imports from production repo and many target events from repo.
No local fake requests provider or shim was detected.
